old_findings.note: allowedRoles is still raw nested keccak (stor[sha3(selector, sha3(target, 0))], 58 lines).
The branchless ternary is still raw: b ^ (c * (a ^ b)) (28 lines).
The operation id keccak is still recomputed on each line (90 lines).

improvements: P6 43 -> 0: the selector constants of the onlyAuthorized prologue print as whole bytes (0x08d6122d..., no longer read as another selector). multicall's bytes[] return encoding reads the free-memory pointer as mem[64] instead of an extra variable, which is exact because nothing in the loop writes slot 64.
notes: The diff is 444 lines; 13 of the 14 changed functions only changed hex display, and I read multicall's diff in full. Both source loops are still whiles (6 whiles). The 38 lines '7 * 24 * 3600' / '5 * 24 * 3600' are the 7-day expiration and 5-day minimum setback: small counts, correctly printed as durations (not P1).
summary: No regression. Only display changes: whole-byte hex constants (P6 43 -> 0) and a slightly simpler multicall encoding.
